text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important use is text understanding, which allows machines to read and find meaning in written words. NLP also makes translation possible, so people can communicate across different languages more easily. Another useful application is sentiment analysis, where computers decide if a piece of text is positive, negative, or neutral. This helps companies learn how customers feel about their products. Finally, chatbots use NLP to talk with people and answer questions in a natural way. Thanks to NLP, our daily technology is becoming smarter and friendlier.
